caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, mountains patterned as dense forest, two jackals confronting each other beside a date palm, red blossoms and tufted herbs scattered over a patterned rocky ground, malachite green, cinnabar red, ochre, azurite blue, jade white
notes_zh: Kalila wa Dimna《Kalila 斥 Dimna》(Met CC0, 18世纪)：双豺对峙+棕榈+花草与纹样坡地。
